caption: The drawing features a rectangular cupboard with straight legs, depicted in a three-quarter frontal view. The cupboard has a structural frame colored in blue, including the top, sides, doors, and legs. The top surface is flat and extends slightly beyond the frame. Both sides and the two front doors of the cupboard are divided into rectangular panels. These panels are filled with a contrasting salmon-pink color and decorated with a dotted and swirling line pattern in a slightly darker red or brown tone. The cupboard has two doors at the front, each with three panels arranged vertically, and each side of the cupboard has three similar panels. The hinges are visible on the left side, and a small round knob or lock is present on the right door. The background is plain and a pale cream color, and a small signature is present in the lower right corner.
title: Food Safe
